draftNote: Read from one blockprint at the resolution of an online scan; doubtful places are marked in the notes, and the text has not yet been collated with other prints.
source: Zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol las: Chos nyid bar do'i gsal 'debs thos grol chen mo, pages 18–26 of the reproduction, from an undated Tibetan blockprint of the Thos grol cycle reproduced by the Buddhist Digital Resource Center as W23710 (text kha), read from the page images. It is a traditional blockprint, so no modern editor's work is involved. Two transcriptions found online, one of this print and one of another, were used to check the reading and are not the text. The page gives the print's wording and spelling. Three things are ours: the spaces between words, which Tibetan does not write; the line-end abbreviations, written out; and clear misprints corrected, each named in its note. Where another print reads differently in a way that matters, the note says so. Letters: the Wylie system (Extended Wylie for the Sanskrit words). Pronunciation: the reading style of central Tibet in the THL Simplified Phonetic Transcription (Germano and Tournadre, 2003), produced by rule from the spelling; a living reader's pronunciation will differ in places. The translation is new, made from the Tibetan. Still to do: the text has been read from one print at the resolution of an online scan, and doubtful places are marked in the notes; it has not been collated with the other blockprints.

sentences.l: Then: the outer-breath stopping's preparation is if, flank right-one, ground on having-laid, then, lion's posture having-made, and, channels' throbbing-waves pressing(?) it-is, and:
sentences.i: Then, when the outer breath is about to stop, lay the dying person down on the right side in the lion's posture, and press the throbbing channels.
sentences.n: de nas, 'then', stands at the foot of p. 17 and opens this part. chad pa'i grabs, 'the preparation of stopping', is 'about to stop'; 'dug na, 'if it is', is the spoken way of saying 'when'. phab is the past of 'bebs, 'to lay down', and byas the past of byed, 'to do': the verbs come in a chain tied by nas and la, as in the pilot. The 'lion's posture' is lying on the right side, the posture in which the Buddha is said to have died. seng ge, 'lion', is printed with the n and g stacked into one letter (སེངྒེ), a common way of writing this Sanskrit-derived word. rtsa, 'channel', covers both the subtle channels of the yogic body and the vessels whose pulse a doctor feels; here it is the throbbing ones. The print reads rtsir ba, which is not a known verb; it is kept as printed, and read, as a guess, as btsir ba, 'to press', which the other recension has; the translation rests on that guess.

sentences.i: When the throbbing of the two 'sleep channels' has stopped, press them hard.
sentences.n: gnyid log, 'sleep', names the pair of channels pressed here; the book does not say where they lie. sentences.l: Then the wind, from-the-dhūtī, outward having-turned-back, the Brahma-aperture's path-along emerges, certain-it-is.
sentences.i: Then the wind is sure to turn back out of the central channel and leave by way of the Brahma aperture.
sentences.n: dhūtī is the central channel of the pilot's p. 16, here printed dhu ti, without its length marks; the next line writes them. tshangs bug, 'Brahmā's opening', is the aperture at the crown of the head, the exit the book wants for the consciousness. thon nges so: thon, 'to come out', with nges, 'certain', and the sentence-ending -so. The other recension says the opposite: the wind, having entered the dhūtī, cannot turn back.

sentences.l: The body-of-truth's mind, inverted not being, one, beings all's mind-stream in dawns, and:
sentences.i: The undistorted mind of the body of truth dawns in the mind-stream of every being.
sentences.n: phyin ci log is 'upside down, distorted'; with ma it means 'undistorted'. dgongs pa, the respectful word for 'mind, intent', was in the title of the cycle. rgyud, 'stream, continuum', is a person's mind running on from moment to moment; the same word means 'tantra' below (mdo rgyud). 'gro ba kun gyi, 'of all beings': this light dawns for everyone, practitioner or not.

sentences.l: That too: the outer-breath stopped, the inner-breath not stopped's interval, in-that, the wind into-the-avadhūtī dissolving's interval it-is, and.
sentences.i: This is the interval after the outer breath has stopped and before the inner breath stops, when the wind dissolves into the central channel.
sentences.n: The print has མཆད, a misprint for མ་ཆད, corrected here: the sentence sets the stopped outer breath against an inner breath 'not stopped' (ma chad), as the other recension has it (ma chad pa'i). ma chad kyi bar, 'the interval of not yet stopped', is how Tibetan says 'until it stops'. avadhūtī is the full Sanskrit name of the central channel; the print writes ā va dhū ti, with the first a long, where Sanskrit has it short, and the last i short.

sentences.l: That to, by-ordinary-people (plural): consciousness fainted they-say. The duration, as-for, fixed there-is-not.
sentences.i: Ordinary people call this 'losing consciousness'. How long it lasts is not fixed.
sentences.n: rnams kyis: the plural marker takes the 'by' ending for the whole phrase, and it marks who says it. zer ro, 'they say', is the spoken verb of saying, with the sentence-ending -ro. brgyal is 'to faint, to swoon'. The other recension has rnam shes, 'consciousness', for shes pa, with the same sense.

sentences.i: It depends on the soundness of the body and on the state of the channels and winds.

sentences.i: So apply yourself earnestly to the pointing-out, and repeat the reminder until a yellowish fluid comes from the openings of the senses.

sentences.l: Great-sinners, and, channels bad's kinds in, as-for, moment one(?), finger-snap one's duration than not remaining too comes. Some, meal eating duration one remaining there-is.
sentences.i: In great wrongdoers, and in those whose channels are poor, it may last no longer than a moment, a snap of the fingers. In some it lasts about as long as it takes to eat a meal.
sentences.n: The syllable re after yud pa is uncertain: two e-vowels can be seen, but not the tshegs around them; yud pa re se gol re'i yun, 'a moment each, a finger-snap each', is the reading taken. The other recension has yud tsam re. las after a noun is 'than': 'not remaining more than'. 'ong, 'comes', here 'it happens that'. la la, 'some'. Where this print gives the length of a meal, the other recension makes it an upper limit: some do not remain longer than a meal's time.

sentences.l: The way-of-giving, as-for: oneself able if, by-oneself beforehand the throw sent. By-oneself not able if, as-for: a lama-or, a student-or, a dharma-companion, mind-heart mingled, one, at-the-side having-placed, and:
sentences.i: As to how it is given: if the dying can do it, they should launch it themselves beforehand. If they cannot, a lama, a student, or a fellow disciple close to them in heart and mind is placed at their side,
sentences.n: rang gi thub na, 'if one is able oneself', has gi where gis, 'by', is meant, the print's habit noted in the pilot. 'phen pa is 'throwing, launching': the dying person sends the mind on its way before the end; the book says no more of it here. btang is the past of gtong, 'to send'; bzhag the past of 'jog, 'to place'. blo sems 'dres pa, 'whose mind and heart are mingled', is a close companion.

sentences.n: The words for a lama are all respectful ones: drung pa, 'one in whose presence one stands', with lags, the polite particle; thugs bskyed, the respectful form of sems bskyed; mdzod, the respectful 'do!'; 'tshal, 'I ask'; snyan, the respectful word for 'ear'; and zhus, past of zhu, the humble verb for speaking to a superior. sentences.l: Appearing and nature without, water-moon like, meditate! Material-having-as not meditate! So clear-remind.
sentences.i: Meditate on him as appearing, yet without any nature of his own, like the moon in water. Do not meditate on him as something solid. Remind him in this way.
sentences.n: The print writes can du as one stacked letter (ཅནྡུ), a contraction written out here; the letters of the stack are uncertain at the scan's resolution, though the sense is not. སྒོཾས, with a small circle for m, is likewise written out as sgoms. chu zla, 'water-moon', the moon reflected in water. gdos bcas, 'having matter'. The other recension reads gdos bcos ma su here, perhaps a corruption; the print's reading is the clearer.

sentences.i: And for those who practised the path before, but have let their vows slip and broken their root commitments, and so are headed for the lower realms, this is needed above all.
sentences.n: The print has ཤོར་བདང, a misprint for ཤོར་བ་དང, corrected here, as the other recension has it. dgos so is printed as one contracted syllable (དགོསོ) and written out. lam gyis is here 'by the path', practice, not 'in a flash'. rtsa ba'i dam tshig, 'the root commitments', are the vows of tantric practice. ngan song, 'bad goings', are rebirth as an animal, a hungry ghost or in hell. ci nas kyang, 'by all means'. glossary.དྲག་པོས: drag pos — by the fierce, by the strong (drag po 'fierce' + -s 'by')
glossary.དྲན་པས: dran pas — by mindfulness, by memory (dran pa 'remembering' + -s 'by')
glossary.དྲུང་པ: drung pa — honoured one, one in whose presence one stands (drung 'presence, front' + -pa): respectful address to a lama
glossary.དྷུ་ཏི: dhu ti — the central channel, dhūtī (Sanskrit, here printed without its length marks; short for avadhūtī)
glossary.ན: na — if, when (after the verb); also 'in, at'
glossary.ནང་དབུགས: nang dbugs — the inner breath, said to go on after breathing stops (nang 'inside' + dbugs 'breath')
glossary.ནམ་མཁའི: nam mkha'i — of the sky, of space (nam mkha' + -'i 'of')
glossary.ནས: nas — from; after a verb: 'having done, and then'
glossary.ནི: ni — as for: marks the topic of the sentence
glossary.ཕབ: phab — laid down, set down (phab, past of 'bebs 'to lay down')
glossary.ཕལ་ཆེར: phal cher — most, mostly (phal cher 'for the most part')
glossary.ཕོག་པར: phog par — to strike, to reach the mark (phog 'to strike, to hit' + -par): phog par bya 'make it land'
glossary.ཕྱག་རྒྱ་ཆེན་པོ: phyag rgya chen po — Great Seal, mahāmudrā: the realisation of the mind's nature (phyag rgya 'seal' + chen po 'great')
glossary.ཕྱག་རྒྱ་ཆེན་པོའི: phyag rgya chen po'i — of the Great Seal (phyag rgya chen po + -'i 'of')
glossary.ཕྱལ་ཆད་དུ: phyal chad du — into a blank, a mere void (phyal chad, a rare word whose sense is a guess from context, + du 'into')
glossary.ཕྱི་དབུགས: phyi dbugs — the outer breath, breathing that can be seen (phyi 'outside' + dbugs 'breath')
glossary.ཕྱིན་ཅི: phyin ci — in phyin ci log, 'upside down, distorted'; phyin ci ma log pa, 'undistorted'
glossary.ཕྱིར: phyir — outside, outward(?). The reading is uncertain; another print has dri med, 'stainless', here · here plainly 'out, outward' (phyi 'outside' + -r): phyir log 'turn back out', phyir thon 'come out'
glossary.ཕྱེད་པར: phyed par — divided, split (phyed, a form of 'byed 'divide' + -par, 'to'); dbyer mi phyed 'not divisible'
glossary.བཏང: btang — sent, let go (btang, past of gtong 'to send')
glossary.བབ: bab — came down, has arrived (bab, for babs, past of 'bab 'to come down'): bab nas 'dug 'has arrived'
glossary.བཞག: bzhag — placed, set (bzhag, past of 'jog 'to place')
glossary.བཞིན: bzhin — in the manner of, like, according to (bzhin 'like'); also 'to be like'
glossary.བཞིར: bzhir — for four, to four (bzhi 'four' + -r 'to, for'); zhag phyed dang bzhi: three and a half days (counting up to the half-finished unit)
glossary.བཞུགས་པ: bzhugs pa — abiding, being present (bzhugs, respectful 'stay' + -pa)
glossary.བཟང་ངན: bzang ngan — good and bad (bzang 'good' + ngan 'bad'): how good, the degree of soundness
glossary.བཟང་བའི: bzang ba'i — of the good, sound (bzang 'good' + -ba + -'i 'of')
glossary.བར: bar — interval, the space between; until
glossary.བར་དུ: bar du — until, up to (bar 'interval' + -du 'to'); after ma + verb + gyi: 'until it comes'
glossary.བར་དོ: bar do — the between: the interval between two states, above all between death and rebirth (bar 'between' + do 'two')
glossary.བར་དོར: bar dor — in the bardo (bar do + -r 'in, into')
glossary.བརྗོད་དོ: brjod do — says, is to be said (brjod, past and future of rjod 'to say', + the sentence-ending -do)
glossary.བརྟན་པོ: brtan po — stable, steady, firm (brtan po)
glossary.བརྟེན: brten — relying on, depending on (brten 'rely, depend')
glossary.བཤེས་གཉེན་བ: bshes gnyen ba — spiritual friend, teacher (bshes gnyen 'friend' + -ba; the print's spelling of bshes gnyen pa)
glossary.བསྐྱེད: bskyed — produced, generated; to produce (bskyed, past and future of skyed 'to produce', the causative of skye 'be born')
glossary.བསྐྱེད་རིམ: bskyed rim — generation stage: visualising oneself as a deity (bskyed 'generate' + rim 'stage')
glossary.བསྐྱེད་རིམ་པ: bskyed rim pa — practitioner of the generation stage (bskyed rim 'generation stage' + -pa 'one who')
glossary.བསྒོམ་ཁོག: bsgom khog — the frame of a meditation, its outline (bsgom, future of sgom 'meditate', + khog 'frame, inside')
glossary.བསྒོམ་པ: bsgom pa — meditating, meditation (bsgom, future of sgom 'to meditate', + -pa)
glossary.བསྟུན: bstun — conform, be in keeping with (bstun)
glossary.བསྟུན་ནོ: bstun no — is in keeping with, depends on (bstun 'conform' + the sentence-ending -no)
glossary.བུ་གར: bu gar — at, into the opening (bu ga 'hole, opening' + -r 'at, into')
glossary.བྱ: bya — is to be done; called (bya, future of byed 'do'): zhes bya 'is called'
glossary.བྱ་བ: bya ba — called; what is to be done (bya, future of byed 'do', + ba). zhes bya ba: 'so called'
glossary.བྱང་ཆུབ: byang chub — awakening, enlightenment (byang chub; Sanskrit bodhi)
glossary.བྱའོ: bya'o — is to be done, one should (bya, future of byed 'do', + the sentence-ending -'o)
glossary.བྱས: byas — did, made, having done (byas, past of byed 'do')
glossary.བྲལ་བར: bral bar — parted, separated (bral 'be parted' + -bar, 'to'); ma bral bar 'without parting from'
glossary.བླ་མའམ: bla ma'am — a lama, or (bla ma + -'am 'or')
glossary.བླ་མས: bla mas — by the lama (bla ma + -s 'by')
glossary.བློ་སེམས: blo sems — mind and heart (blo 'mind' + sems 'heart, mind')
glossary.མ: ma — not (before past and imperative verbs)
glossary.མངོན་དུ: mngon du — manifest, openly, before the eyes (mngon 'clear, manifest' + -du 'to, as'); mngon du byas 'made manifest'
glossary.མངོན་རྟོགས: mngon rtogs — clear realisation, the text describing a deity to be visualised (mngon 'clear' + rtogs 'realise')
glossary.མཆེད་གྲོགས: mched grogs — a companion in the teaching, fellow disciple (mched 'brother, sister' + grogs 'friend')
glossary.མཉམ་པའི: mnyam pa'i — of those equal, equal to (mnyam pa 'equal' + -'i 'of')
glossary.མདོ་རྒྱུད: mdo rgyud — sūtras and tantras (mdo 'sūtra' + rgyud 'tantra'): the Buddha's word
glossary.མནན: mnan — pressed (mnan, past of gnon 'to press')
glossary.མནན་ནོ: mnan no — pressed (mnan, past of gnon 'to press' + the sentence-ending -no); here an instruction: press!
glossary.མཚན་མ: mtshan ma — mark, characteristic, sign (mtshan ma)
glossary.མཛོད: mdzod — please do, please make (mdzod, respectful imperative of byed 'do')
glossary.མཛོད་ཅིག: mdzod cig — please do! (mdzod, respectful 'do!' + cig, which marks a command)
glossary.མི: mi — not (before present and future verbs)
glossary.མེད་དོ: med do — there is not (med + the sentence-ending -do)
glossary.མེད་པ: med pa — without, not existing (med + pa)
glossary.ཚངས་བུག: tshangs bug — Brahma aperture, the opening at the crown of the head (tshangs 'Brahmā' + bug 'hole')
glossary.ཚར་བ: tshar ba — finished, completely done (tshar 'be finished' + -ba); after a verb 'completely'
glossary.ཝལ་ལེ: wal le — distinct, sharp (wal le, descriptive word)
glossary.ཝལ་ལེ་བ: wal le ba — distinct, sharp, crisp (wal le ba, a descriptive word)
glossary.ཞག: zhag — day, a day and night (zhag)
glossary.ཞི་གནས: zhi gnas — calm abiding, meditation that steadies the mind (zhi 'calm' + gnas 'stay'; Sanskrit śamatha)
glossary.ཞུ: zhu — I request, I beg (zhu, humble 'request')
glossary.ཞུའོ: zhu'o — is to be requested, request (zhu + the sentence-ending -'o)
glossary.ཞུས: zhus — said, spoke, requested (zhus, past of zhu, humble verb for speaking to a superior)
glossary.ཞེས: zhes — so, thus: closes a quotation or a name (like inverted commas)
glossary.ཞེས་པའམ: zhes pa'am — so saying, or (zhes 'so, thus' + pa + -'am 'or')
glossary.ཟིན: zin — seized, caught; held (zin, the intransitive verb beside 'dzin 'to hold'): ngos zin 'recognise'
glossary.ཟིན་པ: zin pa — seizing, holding; recognising (zin 'be seized, be held' + -pa): ngos mi zin pa 'one who does not recognise'
glossary.ཟིན་པའི: zin pa'i — of holding, of seizing (zin pa + -'i 'of'): dran pas mi zin pa'i 'whose memory cannot hold'
glossary.ཟིན་པར: zin par — seizing, holding (zin + -par): zin par the tshom med 'no doubt that (they) will seize it'
glossary.ཟུང་འཇུག: zung 'jug — union, joined as a pair (zung 'pair' + 'jug 'enter')
glossary.ཟེར་རོ: zer ro — they say (zer 'say, speak' + the sentence-ending -ro)
glossary.འཁྲུལ་སྣང: 'khrul snang — deluded appearance, illusory vision ('khrul 'be deluded' + snang 'appear')
glossary.འགགས་པར: 'gags par — unceasing, unblocked (ma 'gags par: 'gags 'cease, be blocked' + -par)
glossary.འགྲོ་བ: 'gro ba — going; a being, a living creature ('gro 'go' + -ba: 'one who goes')
glossary.འགྲོ་བའི: 'gro ba'i — of beings ('gro ba 'one who goes', a living being, + -'i 'of') · of going ('gro ba 'to go' + -'i): ngan song du 'gro ba'i 'of going to the lower realms'
glossary.འཆར: 'char — to dawn, to arise, to appear
glossary.འཆི་ཁར: 'chi khar — at the brink of death ('chi kha 'point of death' + -r 'at')
glossary.འཇུག་པར: 'jug par — letting enter, causing to enter ('jug 'enter' + -par); yengs su mi 'jug par 'not letting go into distraction'
glossary.འཇོག་པ: 'jog pa — resting, placing ('jog 'to place, to rest' + -pa)
glossary.འཇོག་པར: 'jog par — to rest, to place ('jog 'place, rest' + -par, 'to'); thog tu 'jog par zhu 'I beg you to rest upon'
glossary.འདི་ཀ: 'di ka — this very, this same ('di 'this' + ka, intensifier)
glossary.འདི་ལྟར: 'di ltar — in this way, like this ('di 'this' + ltar 'like')
glossary.འདི་ལྟར་དུ: 'di ltar du — in this way ('di 'this' + ltar 'like' + -du)
glossary.འདི་སྐད་དོ: 'di skad do — these words (are said) ('di 'this' + skad 'speech' + the sentence-ending -do)
glossary.འདུ་འབྲལ: 'du 'bral — meeting and parting ('du 'meet, gather' + 'bral 'part'); 'du 'bral med pa 'without meeting or parting'
glossary.འདུག: 'dug — to sit, to stay; in speech 'is, there is', like yod; after a verb also 'seems' ('dug)
glossary.འདུག་སྟངས: 'dug stangs — posture, manner of sitting ('dug 'sit, stay' + stangs 'manner'): seng ge'i 'dug stangs, the lion's posture
glossary.འདྲེས་པ: 'dres pa — mingled, mixed; close ('dres 'to mix, to mingle' + -pa)
glossary.འཕར་འཕྲོ: 'phar 'phro — throbbing still going on ('phar 'to throb, to leap' + 'phro 'what is still going on'); 'phar 'phro chad, 'the last of the throbbing has stopped': a sense built from the parts, a guess
glossary.འཕེན་པ: 'phen pa — throwing, launching ('phen 'to throw, to send' + -pa)
glossary.འཕྲོད: 'phrod — to meet, to be received (ngo 'phrod: 'the face is met', to recognise)
glossary.འབའ་ཞིག: 'ba' zhig — alone, only, nothing but ('ba' zhig)
glossary.འཚལ: 'tshal — I ask, I beg ('tshal, humble 'ask for, wish')
glossary.འོང: 'ong — comes, happens, it may happen that ('ong 'come')
glossary.འོད་གསལ: 'od gsal — clear light, luminosity: the nature of mind, said to show itself bare at death ('od 'light' + gsal 'clear')
glossary.འོད་གསལ་དུ: 'od gsal du — as clear light, into clear light ('od gsal + -du 'as, into')
glossary.འོད་མི་འགྱུར་བ: 'od mi 'gyur ba — the buddha Unchanging Light, Light That Does Not Change ('od 'light' + mi 'gyur ba 'unchanging')
glossary.ཡང: yang — also, even, though (written kyang after g, d, b, s)
glossary.ཡི་དམ: yi dam — yidam, one's chosen deity (yi dam)
glossary.ཡིན་ནམ: yin nam — is it? (yin 'be' + nam, 'or' of a question)
glossary.ཡིན་ནོ: yin no — is, are (yin 'to be' + the sentence-ending -no)
glossary.ཡུད་པ: yud pa — a moment, an instant (yud, as in yud tsam 'a moment', + -pa)
glossary.ཡུན་རིང: yun ring — long time, a long duration (yun 'duration' + ring 'long')
glossary.ཡེངས་པར: yengs par — distractedly, in distraction (yengs pa 'to be distracted' + -r): ma yengs par 'undistracted'
glossary.ཡེངས་ཤིག: yengs shig — be distracted! (yengs 'to be distracted' + shig, which marks a command): ma yengs shig 'do not be distracted'
glossary.ཡོད་དོ: yod do — there is (yod 'there is' + the sentence-ending -do)
glossary.ཡོད་པ: yod pa — having, there being; one who has (yod 'there is' + -pa)
glossary.ཡོད་མེད: yod med — whether there is or not (yod 'there is' + med 'there is not')
glossary.རང་བཞིན: rang bzhin — own nature, intrinsic nature (rang 'self' + bzhin 'manner')
glossary.རང་རིག: rang rig — self-knowing, awareness aware of itself (rang 'self' + rig 'know')
glossary.རིག་པ: rig pa — knowing, awareness itself, before any thought
glossary.རིག་པའི: rig pa'i — of knowing, of awareness (rig pa 'knowing' + -'i 'of')
glossary.རིགས་ཀྱི་བུ: rigs kyi bu — child of the family, child of noble family (rigs 'family' + kyi 'of' + bu 'son, child'; Sanskrit kulaputra)
glossary.རིགས་པ: rigs pa — knowing, awareness: rig pa as printed once with a final s (rigs pa); the print elsewhere writes rig pa, and it is read so (rigs pa as a word is 'reasoning, what is fitting', which gives no sense here)
glossary.རིམ་བ: rim ba — order, succession, stage (rim ba, the print's spelling of rim pa): rim ba ltar 'in order'
glossary.རེ: re — each, one each, some (re); after a noun or number it marks a single one or a certain amount
glossary.རེའི: re'i — of one each, of a single (re 'each, one' + -'i 'of')
glossary.རྒྱུད: rgyud — stream, continuum; a person's mind-stream running on from moment to moment; also 'tantra' (as in mdo rgyud)
glossary.རྟེན: rten — support, basis; an object that stands for something
glossary.རྣ་བར: rna bar — to the ear, in the ear (rna ba 'ear' + -r)
glossary.རྣམས: rnams — plural marker, set after the noun and its adjectives
glossary.རྦ་རླབས: rba rlabs — waves, surging; of the channels, their throbbing (rba 'wave' + rlabs 'wave')
glossary.རྩ་བའི: rtsa ba'i — root, principal (rtsa ba 'root' + -'i 'of'; rtsa ba'i bla ma: one's root lama)
glossary.རྩ་རླུང: rtsa rlung — channels and winds (rtsa 'channel' + rlung 'wind'); also the name of the yoga that works with them
glossary.རྩིར་བ: rtsir ba — as printed rtsir ba, not a known verb; read, as a guess, as btsir ba 'to press, to squeeze' (btsir + -ba)
glossary.རྫོགས་པའི: rdzogs pa'i — of the perfect, complete (rdzogs pa 'perfect' + -'i 'of')
glossary.རྫོགས་རིམ་པ: rdzogs rim pa — practitioner of the completion stage (rdzogs rim 'completion stage' + -pa 'one who')
glossary.རྫོགས་རིམ་པར: rdzogs rim par — (as) a practitioner of the completion stage (rdzogs rim pa + -r; the -r is unexpected and its sense uncertain)
glossary.རླུང: rlung — wind; the breath-energy that moves in the body's channels (Sanskrit prāṇa)
glossary.ལ: la — to, at, in, for; after a verb or adjective: 'and'
glossary.ལ་ལ: la la — some, certain ones (la la)
glossary.ལགས: lags — polite particle after a name or title, 'sir' (lags)
glossary.ལན: lan — time, occasion (lan gsum: three times); also 'answer'
glossary.ལམ་གྱིས: lam gyis — vividly, in a flash
glossary.ལམ་དུ: lam du — by way of, along the path (lam 'path' + du 'to, into')
glossary.ལོག: log — to turn back, to reverse
glossary.ལོག་པ: log pa — turned back, reversed, wrong (log 'turn back' + -pa)
glossary.ལྟ་བུར: lta bur — like, as, similar to (lta bu 'like' + -r 'as')
glossary.ཤི་བ: shi ba — dead, one who has died (shi 'die' + -ba)
glossary.ཤེས: shes — to know, to recognise (shes); ngo shes 'recognise, know the face'
glossary.ཤེས་པ: shes pa — knowing; awareness, consciousness (shes 'know' + pa)
glossary.ཤེས་བར: shes bar — to know, to recognise (shes 'know' + -bar, to); the print's spelling of shes par
glossary.ཤེས་རིག: shes rig — knowing-awareness, present awareness (shes 'know' + rig 'awareness'; shes pa and rig pa together)
glossary.ཤེས་རིགས: shes rigs — knowing-awareness: shes rig as printed once with a final s (shes rigs), which the following kyi agrees with; the print elsewhere writes shes rig, and it is read so
glossary.ཤོར: shor — slipped away, escaped (shor, 'lose, slip away')
glossary.ཤོར་བ: shor ba — slipped away, lost (shor, 'slip away' + -ba)
glossary.ས: sa — ground, earth; the earth element (sa)
glossary.སང་ངེ་བ: sang nge ba — open and clear, vivid (sang nge ba)
glossary.སང་ངེ་བར: sang nge bar — open and clear, wide open (sang nge ba + -r, making an adverb)
glossary.སངས་རྒྱས་སུ: sangs rgyas su — as buddha, as a buddha (sangs rgyas + -su 'as')
glossary.སིང་ང: sing nga — vivid (sing nga as printed; the last syllable is uncertain, perhaps sing nge, as in sing nge ba)
glossary.སིང་ངེ་བ: sing nge ba — vivid, bright (sing nge ba, a descriptive word with a doubled sound)
glossary.སེ་གོལ: se gol — finger-snap (se gol, a snap of the fingers)
glossary.སེངྒེའི: sengge'i — of the lion (seng ge 'lion' + -'i 'of'; printed with the n and g stacked)
glossary.སེམས་ཅན: sems can — sentient being, living creature (sems can)
glossary.སེམས་བསྐྱེད: sems bskyed — awakening mind, the resolve to reach awakening for the sake of beings (sems 'mind' + bskyed 'generate')
glossary.སོང་བར: song bar — gone (song, past of 'gro 'to go', + -bar): ma song bar 'not having gone'
glossary.སྐད་ཅིག: skad cig — instant, a moment (skad cig)
glossary.སྐད་ཆུང: skad chung — low voice (skad 'voice' + chung 'small'). The print has skad chung dus, 'voice-low time'; read, as a guess, as skad chung du, 'in a low voice'
glossary.སྐྱར: skyar — to repeat, to do again (skyar, the print's spelling of bskyar)
glossary.སྐྱེ་བོ: skye bo — person, living being (skye bo)
glossary.སྐྱེ་ཤི: skye shi — birth and death (skye 'be born' + shi 'die')
glossary.སྒོམས་ཤིག: sgoms shig — meditate! (sgoms, imperative of sgom 'meditate', + shig, which marks a command)
glossary.སྙན་དུ: snyan du — into the ear (snyan 'ear', respectful + -du 'into')
glossary.སྙམ་དུ: snyam du — thinking, 'so I think' (snyam 'think' + -du): closes the words of a resolve, as zhes closes speech
glossary.སྟེ: ste — and, namely: a linking word after a verb or a statement, leading on to what follows (also te, de)
glossary.སྟོང་པའོ: stong pa'o — is empty (stong pa 'empty' + the sentence-ending -'o)
glossary.སྡིག་པོ་ཆེ: sdig po che — a great wrongdoer (sdig po 'wrongdoer' + che 'great')
glossary.སྣང་བས: snang bas — by the appearance, by the appearing (snang ba 'appearance' + -s 'by')
glossary.སླེབ་བའི: sleb ba'i — of having arrived (sleb 'arrive', spoken + -pa'i 'of'; printed sleb ba'i)
glossary.སློབ་མའམ: slob ma'am — a student, or (slob ma 'student' + -'am 'or')
glossary.ཨང: ang — ang: the letters are clear, the sense is not; taken, as a guess, for a spoken cry that presses a command home
glossary.ཨཱ་ཝ་དྷཱུ་ཏིར: ā wa dhū tir — into the avadhūtī, the central channel (Sanskrit avadhūtī, printed ā va dhū ti, + -r 'into')

about: This part covers the moment of death. As the outer breath fails, the dying person is laid on the right side in the lion's posture and the throbbing channels are pressed. Then comes the interval the book cares most about: the outer breath has stopped, but an 'inner breath' lingers, and in it the clear light of reality dawns for every being. Before the end, a lama or a friend helps the dying person make a resolve: to die for the sake of all beings and to recognise death itself as the clear light. Once the breath has stopped come the words of the pointing-out, which tell the dead person that this present awareness, empty and yet clear, is the buddha Samantabhadra and the body of truth, and that recognising it is enough. Whoever misses this first clear light meets a second a little later, when the consciousness has left the body and he cannot tell whether he is dead. For that moment the book gives instructions according to the practice he did in life. It ends by naming those who most need the reading: those little practised, those whose minds are clouded by illness at the end, and those who have broken their vows.
